about: Golden LED/LCD fixture generated from knob-model.js by tests/js/knob_golden.cjs. Ring entries are ["r,g,b", l] (l = model level 0..4) or null; buttons carry the model tone and light. Compare with tests/test_cc_led_model.py.

pages.a: Caetano Veloso, Gilberto Gil, Os Mutantes & Gal Costa

cases.name: Volume · idle
cases.note: Arc 7→5 o’clock. Body L2, endpoint L3, bound marks L1.

cases.name: Volume · paused, idle view
cases.note: Volume arc as usual. Four buttons lit as on home.

cases.name: Volume · nothing playing
cases.note: Volume arc as usual; Play and Tracks buttons faint.

cases.name: Volume · turning
cases.note: Same arc; endpoint follows each detent.

cases.name: Volume · request pending
cases.note: Confirmed arc L2, requested span L1, endpoint L3 at request.

cases.name: Volume · paused
cases.note: Unchanged from idle. Pause is shown on the LCD, not the ring.

cases.name: Volume · changed elsewhere
cases.note: Arc redrawn at 38; endpoint L4 until next turn.

cases.name: Recently Added · item
cases.note: Landmark per item L1, 3 segments apart; cursor L3.

cases.name: Recently Added · More
cases.note: Double landmark; cursor on both at L3.

cases.name: Recently Added · unavailable
cases.note: Gap where item is; cursor L2.

cases.name: Recently Added · playback pending
cases.note: Cursor alternates L3/L1 until Sonos reports.

cases.name: Recently Added · partial failure
cases.note: Red flash ×3 segments, 900 ms, then landmarks.

cases.name: Tracks · neutral
cases.note: Neutral L2; Prev/Next pairs L1 at ±45°.

cases.name: Tracks · skipped, recentred
cases.note: Green flash at Neutral, 650 ms, then quiet.

cases.name: Tracks · Previous unsupported
cases.note: Prev pair off; Neutral and Next L1.

cases.name: Windows · browsing
cases.note: Landmark per window L1; cursor L3.

cases.name: Windows · closed slot
cases.note: Gap at closed slot; cursor L2.

cases.name: Windows · switch failed
cases.note: Red flash at cursor, then landmarks.

cases.note: Single line, ellipsis at 170 px. Artist keeps its own line.

sequences.name: Volume reveal and hide
sequences.note: One detent: reveal, pending, Sonos ack at 380 ms, hide at 1400 ms.

sequences.name: Paused idle entry and exit
sequences.note: Pause, ack at 420 ms, idle 4 s later; a turn reveals volume over idle; Play exits idle.

sequences.name: Screen change deeper and back
sequences.note: Home → Recent (deeper, +20 px) → More → page 2 (deeper) → Back (−20 px) → Back to Home (−20 px) → Windows (deeper) → Cancel (back).
